🐛 **F-REV-2 OPEN — FIRE-AUTHORABLE (ARCH-6, verified 2026-09-24): the campaign runner runs every E1 leg on the Claim's terrain.** `src/world/Terrain.ts` binds the URL-selected contract at import time and `HeadlessContractSim` takes a `contractId` the terrain never sees; `scripts/gr-sim-campaign.mjs` boots one server with `?debug` and no `&contract`, then loops the Claim and every `e1-*` leg: measured, the Claim publishes `water: { river: true, ford: true }` and Dry Gulch `{ river: false, ford: false, sources: 1 }`, so multi-leg campaigns score the wrong ground. Cure: the sim constructor throws when `activeContract().id !== this.contractId`, and the campaign runner boots one server per leg (or passes the contract). GATE: the campaign test builds the sim and asserts the leg's own water descriptor.

🐛 **F-REV-3 OPEN — FIRE-AUTHORABLE (SIM-4, verified 2026-09-24): the T key spawns enemy packs for the whole co-op party.** `src/core/InputController.ts` maps KeyT with no debug gate; `LockstepClient` emits `debug_spawn` and accepts it, and `Game.ts` applies it unconditionally, while the local path and `debug_xp` are gated per receiver; `injectDesyncAt` is ungated too. Cure: drop `debug_spawn`, `debug_xp` and the desync injector at sample time unless debug is enabled, and discard them in `normalizeAction` in release builds. GATE: a lockstep unit test that a release peer discards them.

⚙️ **F-REV-4 OPEN — AUTHORABLE (PERF-1, ARCH-7, PERF-5, verified 2026-09-24): three per-frame costs around the renderer.** `Game.syncUi` evaluates `pauseMetaSnapshot()` every rendered frame, which reads, parses, re-validates and REWRITES the saved run in localStorage and scans the whole store (about 1 ms a frame as a floor on the owner's Mac, discarded unless paused); `publishDiagnostics` replays the economy log (up to 2,048 events) every rendered frame and is read by twelve release-side consumers, so it is not test-only; `Hud.update` rewrites about 22 DOM properties a frame including an `innerHTML` inside an `aria-live` region. Cures: compute the snapshot only when the HUD shows it (one line), memoise the economy replay by log length, a last-value text cache in the HUD and `aria-live` off the root. GATE: the per-frame work number in the perf census before and after, at 1280 and 390.

📌 **F-REV-5 OPEN — AUTHORABLE (BUILD-2, SIM-6, REPO-2, verified 2026-09-24): the art store is an unpinned build input.** 82 gameplay and terrain JSON files across 8 `src` files are reached through the `assets/pilots` symlinks; no submodule, no lock, no commit recorded anywhere but prose in pin causes; the store has already moved an engine hash mid-heat once (F-HEAT15-1). Cure: an `assetsCommit` field in `assets/engine-era.json` written at pin time and one guard comparing it to the store's HEAD; the gameplay JSON under `map-rebuild-spike` moves into `assets/contracts/terrain/` in a later slice with its re-pin. GATE: the guard reds when the store's HEAD is not the pinned commit.

🤝 **F-REV-7 OPEN — AUTHORABLE (SIM-3, verified 2026-09-24): co-op join refuses a joiner whose saved progress is not byte-identical to the host's, with the same words as a wrong claim word.** `RideTogether.ts` compares `stableStringify` of meta and research and the server repeats it; the second-rider rig overwrites the joiner's meta with the host's before joining, so only humans lack the workaround. Cure: adopt the host's meta and research for the run only, and give a genuine contract or difficulty mismatch its own message. The family playtest on the desk (B1) will hit this first. GATE: a two-browser join with different progress that enters the room.
